description: Source code for Kubernetes resource quota controller, managing quota usage, monitoring resources, and handling resource discovery.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: Manages resource quota usage, monitoring, and synchronization in Kubernetes.

methods.name: NewController
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new resource quota controller with specified options.

methods.name: enqueueAll
methods.description: Enqueues all resource quotas for full usage recalculation.

methods.name: enqueueResourceQuota
methods.description: Enqueues a specific resource quota for processing.

methods.name: addQuota
methods.description: Adds or updates a resource quota in the processing queue.

methods.name: worker
methods.description: Returns a worker function that processes items from a queue.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the quota controller with specified worker count and manages lifecycle.

methods.name: syncResourceQuotaFromKey
methods.description: Synchronizes a resource quota identified by its key.

methods.name: syncResourceQuota
methods.description: Performs a full synchronization of a resource quota's status.

methods.name: replenishQuota
methods.description: Triggers recalculation of quotas for a specific resource in a namespace.

methods.name: Sync
methods.description: Periodically resyncs resource quotas based on resource discovery.

methods.name: printDiff
methods.description: Generates a human-readable diff of resource sets.

methods.name: resyncMonitors
methods.description: Resyncs quota monitors to match current resources.

methods.name: GetQuotableResources
methods.description: Discovers and returns resources that should be tracked by quota system.
